body:
Astra Shastra — Weapons of the Mahabharat
"Yada yada hi dharmasya glanir bhavati Bharata..."

Astra Shastra is a Minecraft mod that brings the legendary weapons of the Mahabharat into your world. Wield the divine arms of gods, kings, and warriors from the great Indian epic — each weapon faithful to its scripture, each with abilities worthy of Kurukshetra.

⚔️ Featured Weapons
Sudarshana Chakra — Krishna's spinning discus. Returns to the wielder. Cuts through anything.
Gandiva — Arjuna's celestial bow. Fires three arrows at once, never misses moving targets.
Kaumodaki — Vishnu's mace. Massive AoE shockwave on slam.
Pashupatastra — Shiva's ultimate astra. Endgame weapon; use with caution.
Brahmastra — Brahma's divine missile. Charge to summon, devastating blast radius.
Vajra — Indra's thunderbolt. Calls lightning on hit.
...and more astras unlocking as you progress.
✨ Features
Lore-accurate — every weapon's behavior is rooted in Mahabharat scripture
Tiered progression — craft mortal weapons first, earn divine astras through quests
Custom models & animations — hand-modeled, not just retextures
Balanced for survival — powerful but costly to obtain and use
Multiplayer-ready — works on dedicated servers
📦 Installation
Install the matching loader for your Minecraft version:
Minecraft 1.20.1 → Forge 47.x
Minecraft 1.21.1 → NeoForge 21.x
Drop the matching astra-shastra-<mcversion>-x.y.z.jar into your mods/ folder
Launch the game
🛡️ Requirements
Minecraft 1.20.1 (Forge) or 1.21.1 (NeoForge)
Java 17+ (1.20.1) / Java 21+ (1.21.1)
